routes.serves: note list JSON that feeds the home page notes area

data_model.viewMode: client-side per-page-load state: 'grid' (default on load) | 'list'; not persisted

notes: REQ-5.1: toggle list/grid views from the home page toolbar. The single toolbar toggle button (id list-view-button, already in the REQ-1.1 header) is a real <button> whose accessible name switches between 'List view' and 'Grid view' as the mode toggles. On load the app is in grid view (REQ-5.2 default) so the button reads 'List view'; clicking it switches the notes area to a stacked list layout and the button becomes 'Grid view'; clicking again switches back to grid and the button returns to 'List view'. Accessible names are copied verbatim from the requirement. View mode is per-page-load client state (state.listView boolean + body.list-view class), so parallel test runs never see each other's mutations; no backend/route/data changes. Existing features (search, filters, sections, actions) are untouched: only the notes containers' CSS layout and the toggle button label/icon change.
